title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في حفل تكريم الشيخ أحمد الريسوني بجامعة شعيب الدكالي
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in a Ceremony Honouring Sheikh Ahmad al-Raysuni at Chouaib Doukkali University
body_ar:
شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو الشنقيطي ـ حفظه الله تعالى يوم الثلاثاء 28 نوفمبر 2017م بوصفه ضيفا أساسيا في حفل افتتاح ندوة علمية ينظمها مختبر الدراسات الإسلامية والتنمية المجتمعية في جامعة شعيب الدكالي بمدينة الجديدة المغربية تكريما لفضيلة الدكتور أحمد الريسوني وسيقدم شهادة عن الدكتور ومن المتنظر أن يلقي فضيلته كلمة ضمن موضوع الندوة المصاحبة للحفل : البحث المقاصدي بين أصالة المنهج ومستجدات الواقع .

ومن أهداف الندوة العلمية الكشف عن الوظائف المتنوعة للنظر المقاصدي و ربط البحث المقاصدي بأسئلة العصر وقضاياه الإنسانية المتنوعة والمتجددة والمستحدثة بما يخدم المصالح الحقيقية للإنسان ويحقق التنمية الحقيقية المنشودة شرعا وعقلا.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew al-Shinqiti (may God the Exalted preserve him) took part on Tuesday 28 November 2017, as a principal guest, in the opening ceremony of a scholarly colloquium organised by the Laboratory for Islamic Studies and Community Development at Chouaib Doukkali University in the Moroccan city of El Jadida, in honour of His Eminence Dr Ahmad al-Raysuni. He will offer a testimonial concerning the doctor, and it is expected that His Eminence will deliver an address within the subject of the colloquium accompanying the ceremony: 'Research in the Higher Objectives, Between the Authenticity of the Method and the Novelties of Present Reality'.

Among the aims of the scholarly colloquium are to bring to light the varied functions of considering the higher objectives (maqāṣid), and to connect research in the higher objectives with the questions of the age and its varied, renewing and newly arising human concerns, in a way that serves the true interests of the human being and achieves the true development sought both by the Sharia and by reason.

flags.note: المقاصدي is an adjective derived from maqāṣid al-sharīʿah, which the glossary renders 'the higher objectives of the Sharia'. English has no adjective for it, so every rendering of a title like this one is a paraphrase. One form should be fixed for the corpus, since maqāṣid titles recur.

translator_notes: A programme notice. The Sheikh's testimonial and address are announced, not reported: the record mixes past tense ('took part') with future ('will offer', 'it is expected'), which is in the source and has been kept.
SOURCE DEFECTS preserved in body_ar: 'المتنظر' stands for 'المنتظر'; the dash opening the honorific 'ـ حفظه الله تعالى' is never closed.
Ahmad al-Raysuni is a Moroccan scholar known for his work on maqāṣid al-sharīʿah; the record's own subject matter makes this plain and nothing has been added.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
